scoring_justification: The agent submits only computed scalars; the checker cannot recompute DFT/NEB from these JSON files, so it compares the agent's reported numbers to the paper's published values with domain-appropriate tolerances.

items.h567: object containing keys 'pentagon', 'hexagon', 'heptagon' each a float in eV
items.r57: object containing keys 'pentagon', 'heptagon' each a float in eV
items.o567: object containing keys 'pentagon', 'hexagon', 'heptagon' each a float in eV

outputs.description: Binding energies of a single Li atom on hollow ring sites of haeckelites. Checker compares each site's binding energy to the paper reference within a tolerance.

items.h567: object containing keys 'Ea_6-5', 'Ea_5-6' each a float in eV
items.r57: object containing keys 'Ea_5-5', 'Ea_5-7', 'Ea_7-5' each a float in eV
items.o567: object containing keys 'Ea_5-5', 'Ea_5-7', 'Ea_7-5' each a float in eV

outputs.description: CI-NEB migration energy barriers for characteristic low-barrier paths. Lower barriers are better; checker scores threshold_or_better using the paper's reported barriers as the threshold.
Maximum theoretical specific capacity of h567. Higher capacity is better; checker applies threshold_or_better with a relative tolerance.
Average open-circuit voltage of h567. Lower OCV is better; checker scores threshold_or_better with the paper's OCV as the threshold.

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are numerical values derived from DFT and NEB calculations. The checker compares them to the paper's reported values with appropriate tolerances. Directional quantities (barrier, capacity, OCV) use threshold_or_better; binding energies use reference_match.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold binding energies from paper Table 3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3, column 'Binding energy of Li atom (eV)' for haeckelites h567, r57, o567.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed exactly from the published table in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the paper's own reported reference numbers used for verification.

hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed exactly from the published table in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The barriers are the paper's computed results; they serve as the hidden threshold for the checker.

hidden_assets.generation_method: Taken from the paper's explicit reported value for both-side lithiation.
